sources.title: SessionLab: Virtual Facilitation
sources.claim: Virtual facilitation requires testing all technology beforehand; expert audiences respect visible preparation

sources.title: Voltage Control: Pitfalls of Poor Facilitation
sources.claim: Unclear objectives, time mismanagement, and over-running discussions are the top facilitation failure modes

sources.title: NCEAS: Hands-On Coding Virtually
sources.claim: Eliminating pre-course software installation via cloud platforms is a critical success factor

sources.title: Faros.ai: AI Adoption in Senior Engineers
sources.claim: Senior developers resist AI tooling due to trust, identity, complexity gap, and time concerns

sources.title: ParallelHQ: How to Facilitate a Workshop
sources.claim: Session length has shortened to 90 minutes; facilitators should treat energy as a finite resource

sources.title: dev.to: Unlocking GitHub Codespaces for Workshops
sources.claim: GitHub Codespaces prebuilds eliminate environment setup delays; free-tier users face 60 hrs/month limits

sources.title: Training for Change: Facilitation Roles
sources.claim: Three distinct roles prevent overload: Lead, Producer, Tech Support; leads must not also operate platform controls

sources.title: EduFellowship: Workshop Design 2025
sources.claim: The 70/30 rule: 70% human conversation and pair coding, 30% tech interaction

sources.title: Mehdio: Running an AI Workshop
sources.claim: Pre-provision individual AI API keys with hard per-participant budget caps ($2–5) and expiry windows

sources.title: Medium: Top 7 Facilitation Mistakes
sources.claim: Overloading with too many exercises and skipping breaks are among the 7 most common facilitation mistakes

sources.title: SessionLab: Parking Lot Method
sources.claim: The parking lot technique captures off-topic questions to keep focus without losing important threads

sources.title: Kaizenko: TDD Deep Dive Workshop
sources.claim: TDD workshops should allocate 60–70% of time to hands-on coding exercises

sources.title: GitHub Codespaces
sources.claim: GitHub Codespaces provides browser-based VS Code with full dev environments

sources.title: Mutedeck: Breakout Rooms in Zoom
sources.claim: Pre-assign breakout room groups rather than using random assignment

sources.title: Stormz: Common Mistakes in Collaborative Workshops
sources.claim: Cognitive diversity should be moderated: too much creates an inverted-U efficiency curve
